    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Arrival
    One scheduled arrival: the turn a customer arrives on, and which type of customer it is.
    Cashier
    The cashier: takes payment from customers who are ready to pay.
    Chef
    Chef cooks one unit of an order per turn, called by the controller class.
    ComboMeal
    A combo meal: two existing menu items sold together at a discount.
    ConsoleUI
    Handles all console output for Restaurant Rush.
    CriticCustomer
    A food critic.
    Customer
    Customer who visits the restaurant, this tracks their satisfaction , id, and state.
    CustomerState
    The states of a customer, from arriving to leaving the restaurant.
    GameConfig
    The setting for one game of Restaurant Rush: how many turns it runs, how many tables the restaurant has, which customers arrive and when, and the targets the manager must reach for victory.
    GameController
    Runs a game of Restaurant Rush: owns the game state and the turn sequence.
    HappyHour
    Tracks the game's one Happy Hour: whether it has been used, when it started, and how many turns it has left.
    Host
    The Host (Stage 3): seats at most one queued customer per turn, in addition to the Waiter's task.
    InputReader
    Reads the manager's choices from the console, or from a file piped in with java -cp out Main < testing/stage1-victory-input.txt.
    InvalidActionException
    Thrown when the manager picks an action that breaks a game rule, for example seating a customer at a table that is already occupied.
    Main
    Entry point for Restaurant Rush, a turn-based restaurant management game played on the command line.
    Menu
    The restaurant's menu: the fixed list of dishes a customer can order as well as a custom menu that the caller can create.
    MenuItem
    entity class to create menu items
    Money
    utility class to format a value into dollars and cents for UI
    Order
    One order placed by a customer: which dish, how much cooking is done, the price locked when the order was taken, and its current status.
    OrderStatus
    The stages an Order passes through from being received to being paid or cancelled.
    PricingPolicy
    How the price of a new order is worked out.
    RegularCustomer
    RegularCustomer losses 8 satisfaction per turn
    Restaurant
    The restaurant: its tables, the waiting queue, every customer who has arrived, the menu and the staff.
    Staff
    A member of staff who can do at most one action per turn.
    Table
    One table in the restaurant.
    VIPCustomer
    A VIP customer.
    Waiter
    The Waiter: each turn, seats one customer, takes one order, serves one READY dish, or waits.
    WaiterTask
    The tasks the manager can give the Waiter in one turn.
